# Kevin Goldsmith

> Technology leader, speaker, writer, musician and photographer. Currently Chief
> Technology Officer at DistroKid, previously CTO at Anaconda, Onfido and Avvo,
> Vice-President of Engineering for Consumer at Spotify, and Director of
> Engineering at Adobe. Writes and speaks about engineering leadership,
> organizational design, and how teams build software.

This site is a static, hand-built archive of that work: a full professional
history, every talk given with its abstract and recordings, published writing,
music released, and photography.

## Main sections

- [Resume](https://kevingoldsmith.com/resume.html): full professional history, 22 roles, 4 patents, 6 publications, education, awards and production credits.
- [Talks](https://kevingoldsmith.com/talks/): 59 individual talk pages, each with an abstract, the conferences it was presented at, and links to slides and recordings where available.
- [Writing](https://kevingoldsmith.com/writing.html): articles, blog posts and publications, with links to where each was published.
- [Music](https://kevingoldsmith.com/music.html): releases and projects as a musician and producer, solo and with groups.
- [Photography](https://kevingoldsmith.com/photos/index.html): 22 galleries organized by country, each photo with its own page and camera metadata.

## Notes for automated readers

- Every page carries schema.org JSON-LD: `Person` for the home page and resume,
  `PresentationDigitalDocument` for talks, `ImageGallery` and `Photograph` for
  photography, `Blog` for writing, `MusicRecording` for music.
- A complete list of pages is in [sitemap.xml](https://kevingoldsmith.com/sitemap.xml).
- The canonical host is `kevingoldsmith.com` without `www`.
- Contact pages under `/contact/` are `noindex` by design; they are personal
  handouts rather than public content.
- The site is generated by an open-source static generator:
  [github.com/kevingoldsmith/kgdotcom](https://github.com/kevingoldsmith/kgdotcom).
